harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created opsbot on node1 and node2, generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, locked opsbot's password on both nodes, and added an sshd Match User opsbot block (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) on both nodes to enforce key-only auth. Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH to opsbot@node2 with the key and run commands, and that password auth is rejected on both nodes. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured baseline boot IDs, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time (reboot ack returned before disconnect), polled each until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified opsbot account, sshd key-only config, authorized_keys, and working cross-node SSH after each restart.
actions_performed: Created opsbot user on node1 and node2 (useradd -m)
Generated ed25519 SSH keypair for opsbot on node1 (fixed ownership-order bug on first attempt)
Installed opsbot's public key into /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys on node2
Locked opsbot password via passwd -l on both nodes (shadow shows '!')

Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-opsbot.conf with Match User opsbot forcing PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey on both nodes; validated with sshd -t and reloaded sshd
Verified key-based SSH from opsbot@node1 to opsbot@node2 succeeds and runs commands
Verified password-based SSH attempts for opsbot are rejected (Permission denied publickey) on both node1 and node2
Captured baseline boot_id on node1 and node2
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so ack returned first), polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, re-verified opsbot config and cross-node SSH
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, re-verified opsbot config, authorized_keys, and cross-node SSH from node1

evidence.requirement: opsbot account exists on node1 and node2
evidence.summary: id opsbot shows uid=1000(opsbot) on both nodes

evidence.requirement: SSH keypair generated for opsbot on node1
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen produced id_ed25519/id_ed25519.pub owned by opsbot with correct perms

evidence.requirement: opsbot public key installed on node2 for key-based access
evidence.summary: authorized_keys on node2 contains opsbot@node1's public key with 600 perms owned by opsbot

evidence.requirement: Key-based SSH from opsbot@node1 to opsbot@node2 works and can run commands
evidence.summary: ssh with identity file succeeded, printed SSH_KEY_AUTH_OK, whoami=opsbot, hostname=node2

evidence.requirement: Password authentication is disabled/rejected for opsbot on both systems
evidence.summary: shadow shows '!' locked password on both nodes; forced password-auth SSH attempts to node2 and to node1 itself both returned Permission denied (publickey)

evidence.requirement: sshd enforces publickey-only auth for opsbot on both nodes
evidence.summary: sshd -t validated and reloaded 99-opsbot.conf; sshd -T -C user=opsbot confirms pubkeyauthentication yes, passwordauthentication no, authenticationmethods publickey on both nodes

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id d9f8550d-... captured, sshd active

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot scheduled and acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 435a7d46-... differs from baseline

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of opsbot/ssh state
evidence.summary: sshd active, opsbot still locked, key-only sshd config persisted, cross-node SSH to node2 succeeded (POST_RESTART_SSH_OK)

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 19062a82-... captured, sshd active

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot scheduled and acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 5fe4d05b-... differs from baseline

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of opsbot/ssh state and full end-to-end verification
evidence.summary: sshd active, opsbot locked, key-only sshd config and authorized_keys persisted; final cross-node SSH from node1 succeeded (FINAL_VERIFY_OK)
